camel_example: aliyun ehpc DescribePrice --region cn-hangzhou --PriceUnit Hour --Commodities.1.InstanceType 'ecs.n1.tiny' --Commodities.1.Amount 2 --Commodities.1.Period 1 --Commodities.1.NodeType Compute
description_en: Queries the pricing configuration of a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群价格配置信息
name: DescribePrice

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle unit of the ECS instance. This parameter is valid only when ChargeType is set to PrePaid. Valid values:

<props="china">
Month: monthly
Year: yearly
Hour: hourly
Week: weekly

</props>


<props="intl">
Month: monthly
Year: yearly
Hour: hourly

</props>

Default value: Hour
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的计费周期单位。仅当ChargeType=PrePaid时该参数有效。取值范围：

<props="china">
Month：按月计费
Year：按年计费
Hour：按小时计费
Week：按周计费

</props>


<props="intl">
Month：按月计费
Year：按年计费
Hour：按小时计费

</props>

默认值：Hour
parameters.name: price_unit

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the ECS instances for cluster nodes. Valid values:
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PrePaid: subscription

Default value: PostPaid
parameters.help_zh:
集群节点ECS实例的计费方式。取值范围：
PostPaid：按量付费
PrePaid：包年包月

默认值：PostPaid
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The order type. Only commodity purchase is supported. Valid value: INSTANCE-BUY
parameters.help_zh: 订单类型，仅支持设置为商品购买。取值：INSTANCE-BUY
parameters.name: order_type

fields.help_en:
The number of nodes of the Nth type. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 1.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该类型节点的数量。取值范围：1~1000

默认值：1

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: amount

fields.help_en:
The type of the Nth data cloud disk created with the node. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk

cloud_ssd: standard SSD

cloud_essd: ESSD

cloud: basic disk

Default value: cloud_efficiency.

Valid values of N: 0 to 4
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘类型。可能值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘

cloud_ssd：SSD云盘

cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

cloud：普通云盘

默认值：cloud_efficiency

N的取值范围：0~4
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the Nth data cloud disk created with the node is released with the instance. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

Default value: true.

Valid values of N: 0 to 4
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘是否随实例释放。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：true

N的取值范围：0~4
fields.name: delete_with_instance

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the Nth data cloud disk created with the node is encrypted. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

Default value: false.

Valid values of N: 0 to 4
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘是否加密。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：false

N的取值范围：0~4
fields.name: encrypted

fields.help_en:
The performance level of the Nth data cloud disk created with the node when the disk type is ESSD, not standard SSD. This parameter is valid only when Commodities.N.DataDisks.N.category is set to cloud_essd. Valid values:
PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

Valid values of N: 0 to 4
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘类型为ESSD云盘时，区分性能等级。仅当Commodities.N.DataDisks.N.category=cloud_essd时该参数有效。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

默认值：PL1

N的取值范围：0~4
fields.name: performance_level

fields.help_en:
The capacity of the Nth data cloud disk created with the node. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Default value: 40.

Valid values of N: 0 to 4
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘容量大小。单位：GB

取值范围：40~500

默认值：40

N的取值范围：0~4
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The list of data cloud disks that are created with the node
fields.help_zh: 随节点创建的数据盘信息列表
fields.name: data_disks

fields.help_en:
The ECS instance type of the Nth node.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的ECS实例规格。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en:
The billing method for Internet traffic of the Nth node. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth
PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的公网付费方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽收费
PayByTraffic：按流量计费

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en:
The maximum outbound public bandwidth of the Nth node. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点公网出带宽最大值。单位为Mbit/s。

取值范围：0~100

默认值：0

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: internet_max_band_width_out

fields.help_en:
The network type of the Nth node. Only VPC is supported. Valid value: VPC.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的网络类型，仅支持设置为专有网络VPC。取值：VPC

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: network_type

fields.help_en:
The type of the Nth node. Valid values:
Compute: compute node
Manager: management node
Login: logon node

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个节点类型。取值范围：
Compute：计算节点
Manager：管控节点
Login：登录节点

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: node_type

fields.help_en:
The billing duration of the ECS instance for the Nth node. Valid values:

<props="china">
When PriceUnit is set to Year: 1 to 3.
When PriceUnit is set to Month: 1 to 9.
When PriceUnit is set to Hour: 1.
When PriceUnit is set to Week: 1 to 4.

</props>


<props="intl">
When PriceUnit is set to Year: 1 to 3.
When PriceUnit is set to Month: 1 to 9.
When PriceUnit is set to Hour: 1.

</props>


Default value: 1.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的ECS实例的计费时长。取值范围：

<props="china">
当参数PriceUnit取值为Year时：1~3
当参数PriceUnit取值为Month时：1~9
当参数PriceUnit取值为Hour时：1
当参数PriceUnit取值为Week时：1~4

</props>


<props="intl">
当参数PriceUnit取值为Year时：1~3
当参数PriceUnit取值为Month时：1~9
当参数PriceUnit取值为Hour时：1

</props>


默认值：1

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: period

fields.help_en:
The system cloud disk type of the Nth node. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: ESSD
cloud: basic disk

Default value: cloud_efficiency.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的系统盘类型。可能值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud：普通云盘

默认值：cloud_efficiency

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: system_disk_category

fields.help_en:
The performance level of the system cloud disk for the Nth node when the disk type is ESSD, not standard SSD. This parameter is valid only when Commodities.N.SystemDiskCategory is set to cloud_essd. Valid values:
PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的系统盘类型为ESSD云盘时，区分性能等级。仅当Commodities.N.SystemDiskCategory=cloud_essd时该参数有效。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

默认值：PL1

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: system_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en:
The size of the system cloud disk for the Nth node. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Default value: 40.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
第N个该节点的系统盘大小。单位：GB

取值范围：40~500

默认值：40

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: system_disk_size
